title: Behind the Pawn
setup: White's b-pawn is a step from the seventh, and the black king on a3 is far too slow to catch it.
hint: The pawn is going to run. Which square keeps your rook attacking it however far it gets?
explanation:
## The Idea

A rook behind a passed pawn keeps hitting it at every step. {{Rb5}} {{b7}} {{Rxb7}}, and there is nothing left to queen. Attack from the side with {{Rf6}} instead, and White plays {{Rb1}}, backing its pawn up, and it goes through.
